title: Use Modal.ButtonRow for modal action buttons (avoids clipped focus ring)
answers: Why is the focus outline cut off on buttons inside a modal?
Focus ring/box-shadow gets clipped on confirm/cancel buttons in a dialog
How should I lay out the action buttons in a modal footer?
Button focus halo looks chopped off at the edge of the modal
body:
Symptom: the keyboard focus ring around buttons at the bottom of a modal (e.g. Confirm/Dismiss) is visually cut off/clipped. Root cause: wrapping action buttons in a plain `
` + `Stack` with only custom padding (e.g. `buttonsContainer: css({ paddingTop: theme.spacing(3) })`) doesn't reserve enough space/overflow for the focus box-shadow at the container edge, as seen in packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx before the fix. Fix pattern: replace the ad-hoc `
...
` wrapper with `Modal.ButtonRow` from packages/grafana-ui/src/components/Modal/Modal.tsx, which already accounts for focus-ring spacing for its children. Constraints: applies to any modal/dialog footer containing action buttons in grafana-ui; don't hand-roll a Stack+div button container with custom padding for this purpose — use Modal.ButtonRow so focus styles aren't clipped.
applies: grafana-ui modal/dialog components with action button rows (ConfirmModal, custom modals built on Modal)
